sbh2.2:1.4: *pratyaśubhatā*, here and throughout, is rendered after Xuanzang’s 朽穢不淨 ‘putrid unattractiveness’ (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.2:3.2: Printed *śoṇitamastakaṁ*, transcribed *śoṇitam astakaṁ*; read *śoṇitaṁ mastakaṁ* (sbh2.5:3.9; Xuanzang 腦, T1579 juan 26). Printed *mūtraṁ* in the slot that sbh2.5:2.9 fills with *yakṛt*; Xuanzang has 肝 ‘liver’ and one urine.
sbh2.2:4.2: Printed *vibhadrātmakaṁ* (also 12.1), corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 變壞 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.2:8.1: Printed text omits the heading and a fifth member after *upakleśa*; Xuanzang has both (云何名為煩惱不淨 … 結、縛、隨眠、隨煩惱、纏, T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.2:11.3: *upacārarāga*, ‘attendance-lust’: lust for the body’s attendance and service (Xuanzang 承事貪, T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.2:13.9: Printed text omits the third charnel-ground passage (cf. 13.1); Xuanzang has it (由憺怕路見彼彼骨，或骨、或鎖。此即顯示或骨、或鎖、或復骨鎖, T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.2:14.1: Printed *maitreṇa rāgāt*; read *maithunarāgāt* (Xuanzang 婬貪, T1579 juan 26; cf. 10.2).
sbh2.2:14.5: Printed *sarvasmāt kāyarāgāt*; read *sarvasmāt satkāyarāgāt* (Xuanzang 薩迦耶, T1579 juan 26; cf. 10.4).
sbh2.2:14.6: Printed *sālambanaṁ saṁbhavaṁ pratyetad ūcyate*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 是名貪行淨行所緣 (T1579 juan 26).
